t s A b o u t C a r e e r s Contact Services Industries Work Insights About Careers Contact Home / Services / Custom Software Development Service Custom Software Development We build custom business software for growing teams that have outgrown spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and manual workflows. From internal tools and dashboards to portals, SaaS MVPs, workflow systems, and API integrations, KP Infotech creates practical software that improves visibility and helps operations move faster. Discuss Your Project All Services What We Do Build the Software Your Operations Actually Need Most growing businesses reach a point where spreadsheets, shared inboxes, and disconnected tools can no longer support daily operations. Reports take too long, approvals get missed, data is duplicated, and teams lose visibility into what is actually happening. Custom software development is the process of designing and building business-specific applications, portals, dashboards, and workflow systems around the way your company actually works. KP Infotech builds practical software that replaces manual work, connects data, and gives teams a clearer operating system for growth. What We Build Internal Tools & Admin Systems — Custom systems for approvals, operations tracking, task management, user management, reporting, customer management, and team coordination. Dashboards & Business Portals — Real-time dashboards, customer portals, vendor portals, partner portals, and role-based interfaces that make operational data easier to access and act on. Workflow Systems — Software that standardizes repeatable processes across sales, inventory, support, finance, HR, field teams, and management. SaaS MVPs & Product Platforms — Focused MVPs and scalable product platforms for founders and teams that need to validate, launch, and improve software without overbuilding. API Integrations — Connections between ERP, CRM, payment systems, databases, cloud tools, websites, and third-party platforms so data moves without manual copying. Web & Mobile Interfaces — Responsive web apps and mobile-friendly interfaces for customers, staff, and field teams when operational access is needed across devices. Built Around Business Outcomes We do not start with technology for its own sake. We start by understanding your process, the people using it, the data behind it, and the business outcome you want to improve. The result is custom business software that reduces manual work, improves operational visibility, supports better decisions, and gives your team a system that can evolve as the business grows. Our Process How We Build Custom Software 01 Discovery & Workflow Mapping 02 Architecture & Product Planning 03 Agile Development 04 Testing & Deployment 05 Support & Iteration 01 Discovery & Workflow Mapping Understand your business process, users, data flow, operational bottlenecks, and success metrics before deciding what to build. 1-2 Weeks What you get → Workflow map → Requirements document → User roles and permissions → Success metrics 02 Architecture & Product Planning Define the application structure, database model, integrations, permission logic, and delivery roadmap around your business goals. 1-2 Weeks What you get → System architecture → Feature roadmap → Database plan → Integration plan 03 Agile Development Build the software in focused sprints with regular demos, feedback loops, code reviews, and visible progress. 4-10 Weeks What you get → Sprint releases → Code reviews → Working modules → Progress demos 04 Testing & Deployment Validate performance, security, usability, data flows, integrations, and cross-device behavior before production launch. 1-2 Weeks What you get → QA reports → Bug fixes → Performance checks → Production deployment 05 Support & Iteration Monitor usage, improve workflows, add features, and keep the system aligned as your operations evolve. Ongoing What you get → Documentation → Monitoring setup → Support handoff → Improvement roadmap Tools & Technologies Custom Software Technology Stack Next.js • React • Node.js • TypeScript • Python • FastAPI • PostgreSQL • Supabase • Sanity CMS • REST APIs • GraphQL • AWS • Vercel • Docker • Cloudflare • Next.js • React • Node.js • TypeScript • Python • FastAPI • PostgreSQL • Supabase • Sanity CMS • REST APIs • GraphQL • AWS • Vercel • Docker • Cloudflare • FAQ Custom Software Development FAQs Everything you need to know about working with us. When should we build custom software instead of using off-the-shelf tools? Custom software makes sense when your team is forcing spreadsheets, disconnected tools, or manual workarounds to manage a process that is central to your business and difficult to fit into standard software. Can you build internal dashboards, portals, and workflow tools? Yes. We build internal tools, customer portals, admin dashboards, reporting systems, approval workflows, and operational platforms tailored to your process. Do you integrate custom software with our existing systems? Yes. We connect software with ERPs, CRMs, payment systems, databases, third-party APIs, spreadsheets, and cloud services where reliable integration is possible. Can you start with an MVP before building the full system? Yes. For new products or uncertain workflows, we usually recommend a focused MVP so you can validate the core process before expanding the system. Who owns the custom software after development? Ownership depends on the project agreement, but we typically build with clear handoff, documentation, deployment access, and support options so your business is not locked into an unclear setup. Ready to discuss your project ? Let's explore how we can help bring your vision to life. Start a Conversation We build custom software, ERP, automation, AI, and cloud systems for growing businesses that need better operations and less manual work. reduce manual work with workflow automation, system integrations, dashboards, approval flows, document automation, and operational tools that keep teams moving without constant follow-up. Discuss Your Project All Services What We Do Automate the Work Slowing Your Team Down Manual work hides inside everyday operations: copying data between tools, chasing approvals, preparing reports, updating spreadsheets, sending follow-ups, and checking the same information again and again. Business automation uses software, integrations, workflow rules, and dashboards to reduce repetitive manual work across teams and systems. KP Infotech designs automation around real operations so information moves faster, handoffs are clearer, and people stay in control where judgment is needed. What We Automate Workflow Automation — Approval flows, task routing, reminders, status updates, escalations, and handoffs that keep work moving without manual chasing. Data Entry & Reporting Automation — Automated reports, dashboard updates, spreadsheet cleanup, form capture, and data movement between systems. CRM & Sales Operations — Lead routing, follow-up reminders, quotation workflows, customer updates, pipeline visibility, and sales activity tracking. Inventory & Operations — Stock alerts, order updates, warehouse workflows, purchase requests, exception reporting, and operational dashboards. Document & Admin Automation — Invoice handling, form processing, document generation, notifications, file routing, and recurring admin tasks. Automation That Fits Your Existing Systems You do not always need to replace your tools to improve your operations. Often, the biggest gains come from connecting the systems you already use and removing the manual work between them. We build automations with clear ownership, error handling, human approval where needed, monitoring, and documentation so your team can trust the workflow after launch. Our Process How We Automate Business Workflows 01 Process Audit 02 Automation Design 03 Build & Integrate 04 Deploy & Train 05 Monitor & Improve 01 Process Audit Identify repetitive tasks, manual handoffs, data duplication, approval delays, and reporting bottlenecks across your operations. 1 Week What you get → Workflow inventory → Automation opportunity list → Pain point analysis → Priority matrix 02 Automation Design Define the automation logic, triggers, approvals, integrations, data rules, exception handling, and success metrics before building. 1-2 Weeks What you get → Automation blueprint → Integration map → Approval rules → Error-handling plan 03 Build & Integrate Connect tools, build workflows, configure dashboards, and test automations against real business scenarios. 2-6 Weeks What you get → Working automations → Connected systems → Dashboards → Test cases 04 Deploy & Train Launch the automation with access controls, documentation, user training, and a clear handoff for day-to-day use. 1 Week What you get → Production deployment → User training → Documentation → Access setup 05 Monitor & Improve Track performance, resolve edge cases, improve reliability, and expand automation as your operations grow. What business processes can be automated? Common automation opportunities include approvals, reporting, data entry, CRM updates, inventory alerts, customer follow-ups, document generation, task routing, and recurring admin work. Do we need to replace our current tools? Not always. Many automation projects connect your existing tools so data and tasks move automatically without forcing a full system replacement. Can humans still approve important steps? Yes. We design workflows with human approval, review steps, exception handling, and audit trails wherever business control is required. How do we measure automation ROI? We define measurable outcomes such as hours saved, errors reduced, faster approvals, improved reporting speed, fewer missed follow-ups, and reduced manual rework. What happens if an automation fails? Good automation needs monitoring, error handling, fallback paths, and clear ownership. We design workflows so exceptions can be reviewed and resolved instead of silently breaking the process. Ready to discuss your project ? Let's explore how we can help bring your vision to life. t s A b o u t C a r e e r s Contact Services Industries Work Insights About Careers Contact Home / Services / ERP & Odoo Solutions Service ERP & Odoo Solutions KP Infotech implements, customizes, migrates, and supports Odoo ERP systems that connect sales, CRM, purchase, inventory, warehouse, accounting, manufacturing, HR, and operations in one reliable platform. Discuss Your Project All Services What We Do Odoo ERP Implementation for Sales, Inventory, Finance, and Operations Most growing businesses eventually hit the same problem: sales, inventory, purchase, accounting, HR, manufacturing, and operations are running in separate tools that do not talk to each other. Data gets duplicated. Reports take hours. Stock visibility is unclear. Purchase decisions are delayed. Finance waits for operational updates. Managers make decisions from incomplete information. Odoo ERP is an integrated business system that connects CRM, sales, purchase, inventory, accounting, manufacturing, HR, and operations in one platform. KP Infotech implements and customizes Odoo so it fits your real workflows, reporting needs, and growth stage instead of forcing your team into a generic template. Odoo Modules We Implement CRM & Sales — Pipeline management, quotations, customer records, sales activities, follow-up workflows, and sales reporting. Purchase & Procurement — Vendor management, purchase requests, RFQs, purchase orders, approval flows, pricing, and procurement visibility. Inventory & Warehouse — Real-time stock visibility, barcode operations, multi-warehouse management, reorder rules, stock transfers, and inventory reporting. Accounting & Finance — Invoicing, reconciliation, tax workflows, payment tracking, receivables, payables, and financial reporting connected to operations. Manufacturing & MRP — Bills of materials, production planning, work orders, quality checks, material requirement planning, and shop-floor visibility. HR, Payroll & Administration — Employee records, attendance, leave workflows, payroll support, recruitment, approvals, and internal requests. Custom Odoo Modules & Integrations — Custom modules, reports, dashboards, third-party integrations, API connections, and workflows built around your business needs. Implementation That Focuses on Adoption ERP success is not just configuration. It requires clean data, mapped workflows, clear user roles, training, reporting, and ongoing support. We help teams move from scattered operations to a system they can actually use every day. Whether you are starting from spreadsheets, legacy software, or disconnected SaaS tools, KP Infotech plans the migration carefully and protects business continuity during the transition. Our Process Odoo ERP Implementation Roadmap 01 Operations Audit 02 Solution Planning 03 Configuration & Customization 04 Training & Rollout 05 Support & Optimization 01 Operations Audit Understand current workflows, department-level pain points, data quality, reporting needs, users, approvals, and gaps across the business. 1-2 Weeks What you get → Current state analysis → Gap assessment → Requirements map → ROI opportunities 02 Solution Planning Select Odoo modules, define target workflows, plan data migration, map integrations, and decide what should be configured versus customized. 2-3 Weeks What you get → Implementation plan → Module map → Data migration strategy → Integration architecture 03 Configuration & Customization Configure Odoo, build custom modules, migrate data, create reports, and connect systems around your operations. 8-16 Weeks What you get → Configured ERP → Custom modules → Migrated data → Integration testing 04 Training & Rollout Train users, validate workflows, prepare documentation, resolve adoption issues, and support go-live. 2 Weeks What you get → Training sessions → User guides → Admin documentation → Go-live support 05 Support & Optimization Improve reports, refine workflows, resolve issues, support updates, and expand ERP capabilities over time. Ongoing What you get → Support reports → Workflow improvements → System updates → Expansion roadmap Tools & Technologies ERP Platform & Infrastructure Odoo • Python • PostgreSQL • JavaScript • XML • REST APIs • Docker • Linux • Nginx • AWS • Google Cloud • Azure • Odoo.sh • Cloudflare • Odoo • Python • PostgreSQL • JavaScript • XML • REST APIs • Docker • Linux • Nginx • AWS • Google Cloud • Azure • Odoo.sh • Cloudflare • FAQ ERP & Odoo FAQs Everything you need to know about working with us. Why choose Odoo ERP for a growing business? Odoo offers a wide set of business modules with strong customization flexibility, making it useful for growing companies that need ERP without the cost and complexity of many large enterprise systems. Can KP Infotech customize Odoo for our workflows? Yes. We configure existing modules, build custom modules, create reports, and integrate Odoo with other systems when standard functionality does not fully match your process. Can Odoo support manufacturing, inventory, and purchase workflows? Yes. Odoo can support manufacturing, MRP, inventory, warehouse, purchase, vendor management, production planning, and stock visibility workflows when implemented around the right process design. Can you migrate data from spreadsheets or legacy software? Yes. We plan and validate data migration from spreadsheets, legacy ERPs, CRMs, accounting tools, inventory systems, and other operational databases. Do you support cloud and on-premise Odoo deployments? Yes. We can support cloud deployments for most businesses and on-premise setups where data control, compliance, or infrastructure requirements make that necessary. Ready to discuss your project ? Let's explore how we can help bring your vision to life. Start a Conversation We build custom software, ERP, automation, AI, and cloud systems for growing businesses that need better operations and less manual work. automation systems that help teams process documents, answer operational questions, summarize data, route tasks, support customers, and reduce repetitive work with clear guardrails and human oversight. Discuss Your Project All Services What We Do Put AI Agents to Work Inside Your Operations AI is most useful when it is connected to real business workflows. Not as a gimmick, but as a practical layer that helps your team answer questions, process information, draft outputs, trigger actions, and reduce repetitive work. AI agents are software workflows that use approved business data and connected tools to answer questions, process documents, summarize information, draft responses, update systems, and escalate edge cases to humans. KP Infotech builds AI automation for operations teams that need speed and visibility without losing control. AI Systems We Build Internal Operations Assistants — AI assistants that answer questions from documents, SOPs, policies, project data, customer records, ERP data, or operational knowledge bases. Document Processing Agents — AI workflows that extract, classify, summarize, and route information from invoices, forms, PDFs, emails, reports, claims, and support requests. Customer Support & Sales Agents — AI-assisted support, lead qualification, response drafting, follow-up workflows, and knowledge-base chat experiences. Reporting & Insight Agents — Agents that summarize operational data, flag exceptions, generate reports, explain trends, and help teams understand what needs attention. Workflow Automation with AI — AI-powered automations that classify work, trigger tasks, draft messages, update systems, route approvals, and escalate sensitive actions for human review. Built With Guardrails We design AI systems with clear boundaries: approved data sources, role-based access, human review for sensitive actions, logging, testing, fallback paths, and evaluation against real examples before launch. The goal is not to replace judgment. The goal is to remove repetitive work, improve response speed, make information easier to use, and give your team better operational leverage. Our Process How We Build AI Automation Systems 01 Use Case Discovery 02 Agent & Guardrail Design 03 Build, Test & Evaluate 04 Deploy & Train 05 Monitor & Improve 01 Use Case Discovery Identify high-value AI opportunities where automation can reduce manual work, improve response speed, or make operational data easier to use. 1 Week What you get → Use case map → Workflow analysis → Data source review → ROI estimate 02 Agent & Guardrail Design Define the AI agent role, approved data sources, tool access, prompts, human approvals, confidence thresholds, and escalation paths. 1-2 Weeks What you get → Agent architecture → Prompt strategy → Guardrail plan → Integration map 03 Build, Test & Evaluate Develop the AI workflow, connect tools, create an evaluation set, test edge cases, and validate outputs against real business examples. 2-6 Weeks What you get → Working prototype → Evaluation results → Edge case handling → Security review 04 Deploy & Train Launch the AI system with user training, usage documentation, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop workflows where needed. 1 Week What you get → Production deployment → Team training → Usage documentation → Monitoring setup 05 Monitor & Improve Track quality, review logs, improve prompts, expand data coverage, and refine automations based on real usage. Ongoing What you get → Quality reports → Prompt improvements → New use cases → Optimization roadmap Tools & Technologies AI Automation Stack Python • LangChain • LangGraph • LlamaIndex • OpenAI API • Claude API • FastAPI • n8n • Make • Vector Databases • Pinecone • PostgreSQL • Embeddings • RAG • REST APIs • Firebase • Python • LangChain • LangGraph • LlamaIndex • OpenAI API • Claude API • FastAPI • n8n • Make • Vector Databases • Pinecone • PostgreSQL • Embeddings • RAG • REST APIs • Firebase • FAQ AI Automation & Agents FAQs Everything you need to know about working with us. What can AI agents do for business operations? AI agents can help answer internal questions, summarize documents, classify requests, draft responses, update systems, generate reports, route tasks, and trigger workflow actions. Can AI agents connect with our ERP, CRM, or internal documents? Yes. We can connect AI workflows with approved data sources such as ERPs, CRMs, databases, helpdesks, spreadsheets, emails, APIs, SOPs, and internal documents where secure integration is available. How do you reduce AI mistakes? We use approved data sources, clear prompts, validation checks, evaluation examples, human review for sensitive actions, logging, and fallback paths when confidence is low. Is business data safe in AI automation workflows? AI workflows should be designed with access control, approved data sources, logging, and clear boundaries. We plan data access carefully and avoid unnecessary exposure of sensitive information. Do we need technical staff to manage AI automations? No. We build user-friendly workflows, provide documentation, and set up monitoring so your team can use the system without managing the technical details day to day. Ready to discuss your project ? Let's explore how we can help bring your vision to life. infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, backups, hosting, security controls, and DevOps workflows for business systems that need to stay reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as they grow. Discuss Your Project All Services What We Do Cloud Infrastructure That Keeps Your Systems Reliable Business software is only useful when it is reliable. Slow deployments, unstable hosting, missing backups, weak monitoring, unclear access controls, and rising cloud bills can quietly create operational risk. Cloud and DevOps services help businesses deploy, monitor, secure, scale, and maintain software systems reliably. KP Infotech helps growing businesses set up infrastructure and delivery workflows that make applications, ERP systems, APIs, databases, and automation platforms easier to operate. What We Help With Cloud Architecture — Infrastructure planning for web apps, ERP systems, APIs, databases, storage, background jobs, automation platforms, and business portals. Deployment Pipelines — CI/CD workflows that reduce manual deployment steps, lower release risk, improve rollback readiness, and make updates easier to manage. Cloud Hosting & Migration — Hosting setup, cloud migration, server configuration, container deployment, database deployment, DNS, SSL, and environment management. Monitoring, Backups & Reliability — Uptime monitoring, logs, alerts, backups, recovery planning, error tracking, and performance checks so issues are easier to detect and resolve. Cloud Cost Optimization — Infrastructure reviews, right-sizing, hosting improvements, usage visibility, and architecture changes that help reduce unnecessary cloud spend. Security & Access Controls — Environment separation, secrets management, access controls, SSL, backup policies, infrastructure permissions, and deployment practices that reduce operational risk. Built for Business Continuity Cloud and DevOps work should make your systems calmer, not more complex. We focus on practical infrastructure that matches your stage, traffic, budget, data needs, and support capacity. Whether you are launching a new platform, stabilizing an existing application, preparing Odoo ERP for production, or improving cloud costs, KP Infotech helps create a reliable foundation for business operations. Our Process Cloud & DevOps Delivery Process 01 Infrastructure Audit 02 Architecture Plan 03 Implementation 04 Monitoring & Reliability 05 Optimize & Support 01 Infrastructure Audit Review hosting, deployments, databases, security, monitoring, backups, access controls, cost patterns, and current operational risks. 1 Week What you get → Infrastructure review → Risk list → Cost review → Improvement priorities 02 Architecture Plan Design a cloud setup that fits your application, traffic, data, security, scaling needs, budget, and support model. 1-2 Weeks What you get → Cloud architecture → Environment plan → Security recommendations → Migration roadmap 03 Implementation Set up infrastructure, CI/CD, hosting, databases, containers, access controls, and deployment workflows. 2-6 Weeks What you get → Cloud setup → Deployment pipeline → Configured environments → Access controls 04 Monitoring & Reliability Add monitoring, alerts, logs, backups, recovery practices, and runbooks so the system is easier to operate after launch. 1 Week What you get → Monitoring setup → Alert rules → Backup plan → Runbook 05 Optimize & Support Improve performance, reduce unnecessary spend, support deployments, review reliability, and update infrastructure as the business grows. Ongoing What you get → Performance reports → Cost optimization → Security updates → Support recommendations Tools & Technologies Cloud & DevOps Stack AWS • Google Cloud • Azure • Vercel • Docker • Kubernetes • Terraform • Linux • Nginx • GitHub Actions • PostgreSQL • Firebase • Supabase • Cloudflare • Grafana • Prometheus • Sentry • Datadog • CI/CD • Monitoring • AWS • Google Cloud • Azure • Vercel • Docker • Kubernetes • Terraform • Linux • Nginx • GitHub Actions • PostgreSQL • Firebase • Supabase • Cloudflare • Grafana • Prometheus • Sentry • Datadog • CI/CD • Monitoring • FAQ Cloud & DevOps FAQs Everything you need to know about working with us. Can you set up cloud hosting for our application or ERP? Yes. We set up hosting, servers, databases, environments, SSL, DNS, backups, deployment workflows, and monitoring based on the needs of your system. Can you improve an existing unstable cloud setup? Yes. We can audit your current infrastructure, identify reliability risks, improve deployment practices, add monitoring, review backups, and create a practical stabilization plan. Do you help reduce cloud costs? Yes. We review infrastructure usage, hosting choices, database resources, storage, traffic patterns, and deployment architecture to identify unnecessary spend and right-sizing opportunities. Do you provide monitoring, backups, and disaster recovery planning? Yes. We can set up monitoring, alerts, logs, backup policies, recovery workflows, and operational runbooks so your team has clearer visibility when issues happen. Do you provide ongoing DevOps support? Yes. We can support monitoring, deployments, infrastructure updates, performance improvements, cost reviews, security updates, and operational troubleshooting after launch. Ready to discuss your project ? Let's explore how we can help bring your vision to life.
